title: Piney
subtitle: a small world of us
startMessage:
Walk with the left side of the screen.
Look around with the right.

Find everything that glows.
The last one is waiting at the biggest tree.
finaleMessage:
someday we will be together.

habang hinihintay natin yun, eto muna.
buong gubat, para sayo.

memories.title: How this started
memories.body:
We were in the same town at the same time in Heartopia. That was the whole reason.

You were curious about the name I was playing under.

you: alam ko lng curious ako
you: sa ginamit mong name nung una
me: ay ou Hahahaha Epstein 🤣
you: it just happen na were on the same town and time

That first afternoon I asked what level you were.

me: ano level kana ulit ?
you: sa puso mo?
you: haha 26

I did not realise it then, but that was the first i love you either of us managed. Hidden inside a question about a game.

We became friends that day and then we just never stopped. We played together every night, and we talked about everything. Work, family, food, the dumbest things. Somewhere in all of that I stopped holding anything back, and so did you.

That is still my favourite thing about us. There is nothing I have to keep to myself.

memories.title: dati wala ako kinoconsider na iba
memories.body:
We were talking about how a hug in Heartopia should not mean anything, and how it did anyway.

you: hahaha if virtual hug mo sa hato
you: means a lot
you: ang babaw man pero I can't explain

Then you said this, out of nowhere:

you: haha dati wala ako kinoconsider na iba ngaun meron na hahahha
me: haha what you mean ?
you: when it comes to thinking about future

you: yeah tipong kahit nagsasandok lang ng kanin tapos maisip mo ngingiti ka eh
you: kasi pistii pag naiisip kta nangingiti talaga ako hahhaa
you: excited din ako mag good morning ka parang tanga lang hahaha

You had never put anyone in your future before.
You put me in it before I even thought to ask.

memories.title: happy ka?
memories.body:
you: happy ka?
me: Sayo? yes
you: me too 😢
you: kaya nakakahurt hahaha
you: nabuang na
me: mas happy if we are together po 🥹

This is the exact minute it stopped being a joke for both of us.

An hour later you called me for the first time. It lasted one minute and then you hung up on me. pangit kausap, you said.

This was around when we started the question game. I would get one from GPT and send it over, and we would go back and forth until it got light outside.

me: hahaha eto next question
you: sige next question
you: sabihin mo next question po

It was the most fun I have ever had doing nothing. It is also where I started dreaming about us — not just talking to you, but an actual life with you in it.

memories.title: Sagada
memories.body:
you: siguro if mag mountain us sa benguet kita dadalhin
you: Mt Ulap or sa Sagada
you: yeah as in parang ayaw mo na umuwi

You went looking for your old photos and sent me one from up there.

me: ang gandaaaa
you: waiting sa sunrise
you: ayoko na nga bumaba eh

me: tayo ka nlng bahay dyan ?
you: basta parang if mgrelocate ako within ph
you: jan ko gusto sagada haha

you: laging nakaka excite pag sunrise and sunset tas malamig hangin kahit my araw
you: if aalis tayo to hike top choice ko yan
you: di nakakasawa

Five days in, and you were already deciding where you would take me.

That whole mountain is pine. That is why this place looks the way it does. I made you the trees while I wait to go and see the real ones with you.

memories.title: The night we finally said it
memories.body:
me: babyyy
me: i love youuu 😘
you: mas mahal kita baby ❤️
me: hahaha mas mahal po kita langga
you: hindi mas ako
you: kulet eh

Eighteen days. That is all it took.

The next night I asked you for something and you gave it to me without even pausing.

me: can you promise po to never let me go ? 🥹
you: ofcourse love don't ever think I will okay?

That is the one I keep going back to. It is what I look forward to most now — that you meant it, that you are never letting go, and that you are going to be my forever.

memories.title: Piney
memories.body:
You told me there is a pine tree outside your place, about your height, and that you water it every day.

I spent ten minutes trying to name it. Pinezilla. Pinocchio.

me: piney sana Haha

This is the thing I want you to know. It was a tree. It was nothing at all. And I was still sitting there grinning at my phone about it near midnight.

We can talk about absolutely nothing for hours and it is still the best part of my day. Hindi mo kailangan maging interesting. Ikaw lang.

memories.title: The day you finally came
memories.body:
Your flight was delayed. You were tired and upset and ready to give up.

you: ayoko na if delay
you: padala ko nalang ito
you: baka ito sakaling makarating sayo
me: adik, ikaw gusto ko 😭
me: wag ka mag worry okay, imprtante makarating ka dito

I waited in the arrivals hall with no aircon and 35% battery left.

At 2:32pm you sent two messages:

you: dito na
you: asan ka

Four months and eleven days after the first time I told you gusto kita mayakap.

And then this, in the car, about ten minutes later.

memories.title: Six days
memories.body:
You landed on the 16th and flew home on the 21st. Six days.

And there is almost nothing in our chat from the 17th to the 20th. Four days of near silence, from two people who sent each other 78,000 messages in five months.

That silence is the loudest thing we have. We didn't need to type anything. You were right there.

I have never been that happy. Six whole days of it, and the whole time it felt like a dream I was going to wake up from.

memories.title: kulang ung araw pati gabi
memories.body:
me: did you have fun sa cebu langga ?
you: yes langga
you: i'm happy
you: kulang ung araw pati gabi

me: sa pinuntahan san pinakagusto mo ?
you: sa kwarto hahahha
you: lahat langga
you: basta magkasama tayo

Kulang nga. Sobrang kulang.

I miss you. Not the way I missed you before, when I only knew your voice. This is worse. Now I know exactly what I am missing.

memories.title: The airport, going home
memories.body:
you: ingat pauwi langga thank you
me: miss na miss na miss na kita agad langga 😭

I sat down in that terminal and had to look at the ceiling for a while so nobody would notice my eyes.

Two hours apart and already missing you.

me: mas namiss ka, nayayakap ko pag gising at pagtulog

memories.title: Sit down for a second
memories.body:
me: mahilig kaba sa monthsary love ?
you: oo eat out siguro, i can't say mahilig
you: pero if we are together maybe i'll start celebrating it

me: Hahaha ako not a fan but ya if ikaw kasama for sure e celebrate
me: i mean its better to make everyday like a monthsary , yung anniversary kasi dapat yung goal Hahahah
you: yep ganun nga love

So that is still the goal.

Happy Monthsary. I promise to keep loving you everyday.
